card.name: Start of new sentence after results
card.fires_on: The first word or period at a sentence boundary right after reported adverse-event or trial results, especially "The median" or "Median" before time to onset, and "There" after a statistic.

modes.label: Median time to onset
modes.description: The word median opening a sentence about time to first onset of an adverse event.
modes.example: The<< median>> time to first occurrence was 12

modes.label: Sentence end after a result
modes.description: A period or closing bracket finishing a sentence of results, just before the next sentence starts.

modes.label: Opening word after statistics
modes.description: A sentence-opening word such as There right after a p-value.

card.plain: It fires at the point where one results sentence ends and the next begins, often a sentence about how long until a side effect began.
